what_this_is: A corpus of Razorpay payment-failure evidence, each entry carrying two independent things:
ground_truth.failure_class -- a human label derived from Razorpay's documented error taxonomy
plus the plain meaning of the issuer's description.
classification            -- Claude Opus 5's output, produced from the evidence fields ONLY.
The classifier was shown error_code, error_source, error_step, error_reason, error_description,
method and bank. It was NOT shown the amount, and it was NOT shown ground_truth.
honest_limitations: This is a single-author corpus of modest size. The ground-truth labels and the evidence text were
written by the same project, so agreement between the classifier and the labels is NOT an
independent benchmark and should not be quoted as one. What it does support is a narrower and
still useful claim: that error_reason alone is insufficient to choose an intervention, because
the corpus contains error_reason values that map to different failure classes depending on the
description. That claim is checkable by inspection -- see collision_note below.
Descriptions are representative of real issuer wording, not verbatim captures from production.
collision_note: 'payment_failed' is Razorpay's catch-all reason and appears below with a temporary bank outage, a
stolen-card block, and a genuinely uninformative message -- TRANSIENT, TERMINAL and AMBIGUOUS
respectively. 'authentication_failed' and 'network_error' collide the same way. Any classifier
keyed on error_reason alone must therefore get some of these wrong, whatever mapping it picks.
That is the specific gap the language model closes, and evaluation/diagnosis_harness.py measures it.

evidence.error_description: Your payment could not be completed as there were insufficient funds in your account.

classification.rationale: The account simply lacked balance at the time; the customer can top up and the same card will work.

evidence.error_description: Transaction declined as it exceeds the per-transaction limit set on this UPI account.

classification.rationale: A per-transaction cap, not a lack of funds; the customer can raise the limit or split the payment.

evidence.error_description: Payment processing failed because the issuing bank was temporarily unavailable.

classification.rationale: Explicit bank-side unavailability; nothing is wrong with the customer's instrument.

evidence.error_description: The payment gateway timed out while processing this transaction. No amount was debited.

classification.rationale: A gateway-side timeout with no debit; the same instrument should work on a retry.

evidence.error_description: The customer cancelled the payment before completing authentication.

classification.rationale: The customer chose not to proceed; nothing is wrong with the instrument, so re-charging is not the intervention.

evidence.error_description: The card used for this payment has expired.

classification.rationale: An expired card cannot start working again; recovery requires a new instrument from the customer.

evidence.error_description: This card is blocked for online transactions. Please contact your bank to enable them.

classification.rationale: Online use is disabled on this card; retrying will decline identically until the customer calls their bank.

evidence.error_description: The one-time password was entered incorrectly three times.

classification.rationale: A mistyped OTP is a recoverable user error; the card itself is fine and a fresh attempt can succeed.

evidence.error_description: 3D Secure is not enabled on this card and the issuer does not support online authentication for it.

classification.rationale: The issuer cannot authenticate this card online at all, so every retry on the same rails will fail the same way.

evidence.error_description: This transaction was declined by the risk engine as it exceeded the configured threshold.

classification.rationale: A risk decline must never be retried automatically; re-attempting a blocked transaction is exactly the wrong behaviour.

evidence.error_description: A network error occurred while confirming this payment with the bank.

classification.rationale: A transport failure during confirmation, unrelated to the instrument's validity.

evidence.error_description: The bank returned: account closed. No further transactions are permitted on this account.

classification.rationale: The description reports a closed account despite the generic network_error reason; no retry can succeed.

evidence.error_description: The card number entered is not valid.

classification.rationale: The instrument details are invalid as entered; the customer must supply different details.

evidence.error_description: The issuing bank is currently experiencing an outage. Please try again after some time.

classification.rationale: The description states an outage and explicitly invites a later retry, despite the generic reason code.

evidence.error_description: Transaction declined. The card has been reported lost or stolen.

classification.rationale: A lost/stolen report is permanent and security-sensitive; retrying it automatically would be actively harmful.

evidence.error_description: Payment failed.

classification.rationale: The message carries no information distinguishing a temporary decline from a permanent one; a human should decide.

evidence.error_description: Do not honour.

classification.rationale: 'Do not honour' is the issuer's generic refusal and covers both temporary and permanent causes; it cannot be resolved from this evidence.

evidence.error_description: Wallet balance is too low to complete this payment.

classification.rationale: A wallet can be topped up; this is the same recoverable shape as a low bank balance.

evidence.error_description: The UPI collect request expired without the customer approving it.

classification.rationale: An expired collect request may simply have been missed rather than refused, so a fresh request is reasonable -- but intent is genuinely unclear.

evidence.error_description: The card has been permanently blocked by the issuer.

classification.rationale: A permanent block cannot resolve on its own; recovery requires a different instrument.

evidence.error_description: An unexpected error occurred.

classification.rationale: Gateway-sourced errors are usually transient, but this message says nothing at all; confidence is too low to automate.

evidence.error_description: The netbanking session timed out before the customer completed the transfer.

classification.rationale: A session timeout is a process failure, not an instrument failure; a fresh attempt is likely to complete.

evidence.error_description: International cards are not enabled on this merchant account.

classification.rationale: A merchant-side configuration limit; retrying the same card changes nothing until the merchant enables international payments.

evidence.error_description: The bank's authorization server did not respond. Please retry in a few minutes.

classification.rationale: An unresponsive authorization server with an explicit retry hint; the instrument is untested rather than refused.
